title: Gravity, Mass and Weight
summary: Newton's law of gravitation, free fall, g on Earth and other worlds, and the difference between mass and weight.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 6: How Forces Affect Motion (weight, F = mg)

objectives: I can describe Newton's law of gravitation and the inverse square law.
I can distinguish between mass and weight and calculate W = mg.
I can explain why all objects fall with the same acceleration without air resistance.
misconceptions: Heavy objects fall faster than light ones.
There is no gravity in space.
Mass and weight are the same, and both change on the Moon.
